judged_text: The {{#unless automatic}} guard around the remove link evaluates the `automatic` property in the member (User) context, where it does not exist, so the guard is always true. The remove × link is rendered for automatic groups' members in the admin UI; clicking it triggers removeMember, the server returns 422, and the admin sees a remove affordance that can never work — the automatic-group invariant is enforced only server-side and contradicted by the UI.

adjudication.rationale: In `admin/templates/group_member.hbs` the remove link is guarded with `{{#unless automatic}} ... {{/unless}}`, but this item view is rendered per-member via `{{each member in members itemView="group-member"}}`. The `automatic` flag is a Group property (used in `admin/templates/group.hbs`), not a User/member property, and `group-member.js.es6` does not pass/alias `automatic` into the item view. As a result the guard will not correctly reflect the group’s `automatic` state and can render the remove affordance even for automatic groups. Clicking it calls `removeMember`, and the server enforces the invariant (`Admin::GroupsController#remove_member` returns 422 for `group.automatic`).
